interpretation: A/B share35 joint-window calls, architecture, training exposures and grids with each other. Their graph-dependent compute and wallclock can still differ.

PVB10 denotes steps per physical transition, not ten evaluations for the entire12-frame window. Conversely A/B35 calls each process twelve current geometries, so a35-versus120 comparison does not establish cheaper compute.
Graph construction counts and frame counts are not FLOPs: layer counts, neighbors, temporal/token interactions, vector dimensions, condition encoders and final decoding differ.

Compare measured GPU-hours and peak memory alongside these definitions. Native PVB autoregression, H1 and released pretraining differ from A/B H4 joint generation; do not call the reference comparison a single-factor ablation.
